description:
Job Title : Windows 10 Developer 
 Location : San Francisco, CA 
 Duration: 4+ Months 
 
 
 
 Responsibilities : 
 o Develop high-performance, reliable, testable and maintainable code. 
 o Develop user interfaces and interactions with nuance and attention to detail. Iterate rapidly with designers to create a delightful user experience. 
 o Work well both independently and collaboratively within a fast-moving development team, with clear, positive, and constructive communication. 
 
 
 
 Requirements : 
 o Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent experience. 
 o 5+ years overall development experience including desktop tools. 
 o Windows native application experience, preferably with knowledge of Windows 10 and the UWP platform. 
 o Mac native application experience a plus 
 o Strong C++ experience. CX and/or Objective-C experience is a plus 
 o Front-end web development experience a plus - specifically, JavaScript, HTML and CSS. 
 o Experience with graphics programming, especially vector graphics. Deeper technical understanding of vector rendering/compositing stacks (both CPU and GPU side) a plus. 
 o Experience developing for multiple devices and platforms a plus. 
 o Experience with Agile development processes including Scrum. 
 o Proven results-oriented person - especially in the areas of writing high-performance, reliable and maintainable code. 
 o Works well in a distributed team environment across multiple geographies 
 o Ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. 
 o Ability to work well under pressure. 
 o Excellent verbal and written communication skills; can effectively articulate complex ideas and influence others through well-reasoned explanations. 


 Thanks & Regards’ 
 ________________________________________________________________________ ___ 
 Vikram Bhalla | Team Recruitment | Mindlance, Inc. | W : 732 504 6695 
 
 
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
